result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial intersection with significant pedestrian exposure and minimal crossing infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, the lack of marked crosswalks, refuge islands, or visible pedestrian signals at this wide crossing creates a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge or marked path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and middle ground across the wide asphalt expanse

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Priority
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible to indicate where or when pedestrians should cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow turning vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a signalized intersection. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the long crossing distance and lack of high-visibility crosswalk markings create a challenging environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no visible painted crosswalks at the signalized intersection to guide pedestrians or alert drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility and define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island Enhancement
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing painted/low-profile island into a raised, protected refuge to reduce exposure time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a T-junction with a commercial land use context. While sidewalks are present, there is a complete lack of marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps at this intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without dedicated infrastructure.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, making pedestrian movements unpredictable to drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has traffic lights for vehicles but no walk/don't-walk signals for pedestrians.

hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb with no ramp, creating an accessibility barrier for people with mobility devices.
